entries.Translated: 打开配置窗口/修改配置

entries.Original: moves to the flag map marker
entries.Translated: 移动到 flag 地图标记

entries.Original: opens packs, registers cards and sells the rest
entries.Translated: 打开包裹，登记卡片，然后卖掉剩下的。

entries.Original: starts auto duty in territory type specified
entries.Translated: 在指定领土类型开始汽车服务

entries.Original: Logs and copies your target's dataid to clipboard
entries.Translated: 将目标数据记录并复制到剪贴板

boss Loot 测试##DevBossLoot 测试

entries.Original:
Adds more dungeons into the leveling list
These dungeons are currently in testing for reliability
Please report if you have issues with them
entries.Translated:
将更多地下城添加到等级列表
这些地牢目前正在进行可靠性测试。
如果您对他们有任何问题，请向我们报告。

entries.Original:
This dungeon is currently in testing for reliability.
Do report any issues with it
entries.Translated:
这个地牢目前正在进行可靠性测试。
请报告任何问题

entries.Original: You need to do the basic setup below. Enjoy
entries.Translated: 您需要完成以下基本设置。尽情享受吧。
在 Ko-Fi 上支持 erdelf

entries.Original: All Targets Can Attack aka Tank/Autoduty Mode
entries.Translated: 所有目标都可以在坦克/自动驾驶模式下攻击

entries.Original: All Targets When Solo In Duty
entries.Translated: 独自执行任务时的所有目标
独自执行任务时的所有目标
输入以 / 开头的命令
打开 Crucible 主板地图

entries.Original: CutsceneSkip detected. Please keep it actually on.
entries.Translated: 检测到 CutsceneSkip。请务必保持开启状态。

entries.Original: Please type in "/xlbranch" and pick Release, then restart the game.
entries.Translated: 请输入 “/xlbranch” 并选择 “Release”，然后重启游戏。

entries.Original: Use despite staging. Support will not be given##stagingHeader
entries.Translated: 尽管已经注册但仍然使用。不会提供支持##stageingHeader

entries.Original: You are off the board (fight arena?)
There is a camp before the next fight
entries.Translated: 在下一场战斗之前有一个营地

entries.Original: There is no camp before the next fight
entries.Translated: 在下一场战斗之前没有营地

resources.Original: Config is locked while IPC config overrides are active. Stop AutoDuty to edit again.
resources.Translated: 当 IPC 配置覆盖处于活动状态时，配置处于锁定状态。停止 AutoDuty 再次编辑。

resources.Original: The following are buttons available in Overlay/Maintab
resources.Translated: 以下是覆盖/Maintab 中可用的按钮。

resources.Original: Open enabled Loop Actions by default
resources.Translated: 默认打开已启用循环操作

resources.Original: Wait x milliseconds before leaving a duty
resources.Translated: 等待 x 毫秒后离开岗位

resources.Original: Can in most cases be kept to 0
resources.Translated: 在大多数情况下可以保持为 0

resources.Original: Disables rendering the 3D world while AutoDuty is active
resources.Translated: 在 AutoDuty 处于活跃状态时禁止渲染 3D 世界

resources.Original: Execute commands on start of all loops
resources.Translated: 在所有循环开始时执行命令

resources.Original:
Execute commands on start of all loops
For example {0}
resources.Translated:
在所有循环开始时执行命令
例如{0}

resources.Original: The following are also done between loop, if Between Loop is enabled (currently {0})
resources.Translated: 如果启用了 Between Loop(当前为{0})，循环之间也会执行以下操作。
从 Between Loop 复制操作
在最后一个循环上运行

resources.Original: Will entrust items to the armoire between loops.
resources.Translated: 将在循环间隙将物品托付给衣柜。

resources.Original: Will entrust items to the glamour chest between loops.
resources.Translated: 将把物品托付给那个魅力四射的箱子，在两次循环之间。

resources.Original: Will cycle through all your characters in ARs MultiMode once and then return to running the duty
resources.Translated: 将在 ARs MultiMode 中循环一次您的所有角色，然后返回执行任务。

resources.Original: Looping will stop when these conditions are reached, so long as an adequate number of loops have been allocated.
resources.Translated: 当达到这些条件时，只要分配了足够数量的循环，循环就会停止。
停止循环 @ 项目级别

resources.Original: Stop Looping when all Glam is Gathered
resources.Translated: 当所有魅力都聚集在一起时停止循环

resources.Original: Looping will stop when the glam of the current duty is gathered.
resources.Translated: 循环将在当前职责的魅力聚集时停止。

resources.Original: Stop Looping when Inventory is full

Execute commands on termination of all loops
For example {0}
resources.Translated:
在所有循环结束时执行命令
例如{0}

resources.Original: Hold CTRL to delete an entry
resources.Translated: 按住 CTRL 删除条目

resources.Original: Start typing NPC or zone name to search
resources.Translated: 开始键入 NPC 或区域名称进行搜索

resources.Original: If in playlist mode, changes gear set to the first entry's specified gearset
resources.Translated: 如果在播放列表模式下，将齿轮设置更改为第一个项目的指定齿轮设置

resources.Original: If in playlist mode, changes gear set to the next entry's specified gearset, and switches the active loop to the next playlist entry, if applicable
resources.Translated: 如果在播放列表模式下，将齿轮设置更改为下一个条目的指定齿轮设置，并将活跃循环切换到下一个播放列表条目 (如果适用)

resources.Original: Will entrust items to the armoire
Will entrust items to the glamour chest
resources.Translated: 将物品托付给魅力之箱

resources.Original: Protect Gearsetter upgrades from Auto Desynth
resources.Translated: 保护 Gearsetter 升级免受 Auto Deynth 的影响

resources.Original: Also protects items that Gearsetter recommends as an upgrade for any of your gearsets, even if they aren't equipped in one yet. Requires the Gearsetter plugin.
resources.Translated: 此外，它还能保护 Gearsetter 推荐用于升级任何齿轮组的项目，即使这些项目尚未安装在齿轮组中。需要 Gearsetter 插件。

resources.Original: AutoDuty will open gear coffers (like paladin arms)
resources.Translated: AutoDuty 将打开装备箱 (如同圣骑士的武器)

resources.Original:
Squadron will retire to barracks.
Crucible will do absolutely nothing
resources.Translated:
中队将退回营房。
Crucible 绝对不会采取任何行动

resources.Original: Waits on the specified plugins to be done with their actions
resources.Translated: 在指定插件上等待其操作完成

resources.Original: Limited Jobs cannot run Trust, Duty Support, Squadron or Variant dungeons. Please switch jobs or select a different category.
resources.Translated: 有限任务无法运行信任、职责支持、飞行队或变体地牢。请切换任务或选择其他类别。

resources.Original: Crucible can only be run by Beastmaster
An estimate of how many more dungeons you can still run before reaching the daily limit of 100 duties.
resources.Translated: 估算一下，在达到每日 100 个任务的上限之前，你还能跑多少个地下城。

resources.Original:
Team is full ({0} max)
Untick one to pick another
resources.Translated:
团队满员 ({0} max)
取消选择一个来选择另一个

resources.Original:
Forget saved ranks
Hold Ctrl and click
resources.Translated:
忘记保存的等级
按住 Ctrl 并单击

resources.Original: No familiars known yet. Open the team or bestiary at Lauda so AutoDuty can read them.
resources.Translated: 目前尚未发现家族成员。在 Lauda 打开团队或动物图鉴，让 AutoDuty 阅读。

resources.Original: Top is bought first · Drag the handle or type a new # to move an item · Hover a name for details
resources.Translated: 首先购买顶部 · 拖动手柄或键入新的 # 来移动物品 · 悬停名称以查看详细信息

resources.Original:
Won't be bought or used.
Hold Ctrl to set everything in the category
resources.Translated:
不会购买或使用。
按住 Ctrl 键设置类别中的所有内容

resources.Original: The shop list AutoDuty buys from
resources.Translated: AutoDuty 从哪里购买商店列表
重新命名这个商店列表

resources.Original: Add a shop list with the default order
resources.Translated: 添加具有默认顺序的商店列表

resources.Original: Add a copy of this shop list
resources.Translated: 添加此商店列表的副本

resources.Original:
Delete this shop list
Hold Ctrl and click
The last list can't be deleted
resources.Translated:
删除此商店列表
按住 Ctrl 并单击
无法删除最后一个列表

resources.Original:
Put this list back in the default order
Hold Ctrl and click
resources.Translated:
将此列表恢复为默认顺序
按住 Ctrl 并单击

resources.Original: Copy this shop list to the clipboard
resources.Translated: 将此商店列表复制到剪贴板
商店列表复制到剪贴板。

resources.Original:
Add a new shop list from the clipboard
Takes an exported list or plain item IDs
Items it leaves out are added at the end
resources.Translated:
从剪贴板添加新的商店列表
获取导出的列表或普通项目 ID
它遗漏的项目会在末尾添加。

resources.Original: Unable to import the shop order from the clipboard.
resources.Translated: 无法从剪贴板导入商店订单。

resources.Original: Shaded: the team this mode takes · Hover a name for stats
resources.Translated: 阴影：这个模式带来的团队 · 为统计数据保留一个名称

resources.Original: Ticked: the team you take · Hover a name for stats
resources.Translated: 标记：你带的团队 · 为统计数据保留一个名称

resources.Original:
Rank not read yet
Read from the bestiary at the next team setup
resources.Translated:
排名尚未读取
在下一个团队设置中阅读动物寓言

resources.Original: Crucible requires at least 3 beasts selected
resources.Translated: 坩埚需要至少 3 只选定的野兽

resources.Original:
Takes your highest rank familiars
Ties go to the best stats
resources.Translated:
带走您最高级别的亲属
连接到最佳统计数据

resources.Original:
Takes your lowest rank familiars, least EXP first
The same order picks who fights each battle
resources.Translated:
先挑选最低等级的亲随，经验最少的优先。
同一个命令选择谁在每场战斗中战斗

resources.Original:
Takes the familiars you tick below
Up to 10
resources.Translated:
带走你在下面勾选的熟悉的人
最多 10 个

resources.Original: Uses 3 less than the maximum amount

Uses your 3 highest familiars, then fills the rest with your lowest.
Uses 2 less than maximum amount.
resources.Translated:
使用你最高的 3 个亲和力，然后用你最低的亲和力填充剩下的。
使用量小于最大值 2。

resources.Original: Only uses 3 familiars at a time
resources.Translated: 一次仅使用 3 名家庭成员

resources.Original: Prevent items with detrimental effect without immunity to said effect
resources.Translated: 防止具有不利影响的物品，但不免疫该影响
不使用 AutoDuty 运行菜单 (测试)

resources.Original:
Picks up to 3 familiars for each battle and commences it
Knocked out familiars are skipped
resources.Translated:
每场战斗最多挑选 3 个亲随，然后开始
被击昏的家人被跳过

resources.Original: Takes all loot after a battle
resources.Translated: 在战斗结束后取走所有战利品

resources.Original: Takes one treasure: healing first, then defense, then damage
resources.Translated: 拿走一件宝贝：先治疗，然后防御，最后造成伤害

resources.Original:
Spends coins on healing items, then Beast Gear, then one feed
Leaves the shop when done
resources.Translated:
花钱购买治疗道具，然后是兽装，最后是一次喂食。
完成后离开店铺

resources.Original:
Rests with up to 2 familiars under 60% HP
With none picked you get the 90% self heal instead
resources.Translated:
与多达 2 名家族成员一起休息，HP 低于 60%
没有任何选择，你反而能获得 90% 的自愈

resources.Original:
Uses healing items when your HP is low
In battle: under 40%  ·  On the board: under 60%
resources.Translated:
在 HP 低时使用治疗道具
在战斗中：低于 40% ·在战场上：低于 60%

resources.Original:
Doesn't buy gear with a detrimental effect until you have gear that grants immunity to it:
Demonic Helm needs Soulreaper's Armor
Thunder Axe needs Umbral Wristlet
resources.Translated:
不要购买具有不利影响的装备，除非你拥有能够免疫它的装备：
恶魔头盔需要灵魂收割者的盔甲
雷神斧 (Thunder Axe) 需要 Umbreal 手镯

resources.Original:
For testing without paths
Talking to Lauda sets up the team, challenges the board and commences
On a board, the menus above run while you walk it yourself
resources.Translated:
用于无路径测试
与劳达交谈组建团队，挑战董事会，然后开始
在看板上，上面的菜单在你自己走动时运行。

resources.Original:
Deletes the saved Playlist
Hold ctrl to enable
resources.Translated:
删除保存的播放列表
按住 ctrl 键以启用

resources.Original:
Saves the current Playlist with the name written
Hold ctrl to enable
resources.Translated:
将当前播放列表存储为已写名称
按住 ctrl 以启用
